### The Folly of Fighting the Lord
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/folly-of-fighting-the-lord
Passage: 2 Chronicles 13:12
Points:
- King Abijah warned Israel that waging war against the Lord and His covenant order could never succeed.
- Despite Jeroboam's superior numbers and tactical ambush, God intervened and routed Israel before Judah.
- Although Abijah was flawed overall, the Chronicler highlights this pivotal episode of reliance on God.
- Believers are reminded that no adversary can ultimately defeat those who worship God in spirit and truth.
- Honoring God's worship and covenant assures the church of Christ's ultimate victory over all enemies.
